algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is an adaptive sequential simulated annealing with adaptive cooling schedule and Gaussian perturbation, which iteratively samples candidates around the current best solution, accepts or rejects new solutions based on a probabilistic acceptance criterion, and gradually decreases the temperature to converge towards the optimal solution.}
{The proposed algorithm is a hybrid of the Simulated Annealing (SA) and Differential Evolution (DE) methods, leveraging SA's ability to escape local optima with DE's efficiency in exploration.}
